{{Top|leg}}
The '''Narglatch Airtech prefabricated kit''' was a product of [[Narglatch AirTech/Legends|Narglatch AirTech]]. The kits contained [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] components that a buyer could use to build their own custom airspeeder. The [[XJ-6 airspeeder/Legends|XJ-6 airspeeder]], owned by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade]], and [[XJ-2 airspeeder/Legends|XJ-2 airspeeder]], owned by Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], were both constructed using prefabricated kits manufactured by Narglatch AirTech.
